title: Visual Tool Prototype Intake and Maturity Comparison
purpose: Bring existing visual tool prototypes together for comparison and maturity analysis before designing the unified GlyphForge Visual Tool Suite.
boundaries: No existing evidence flipbooks are moved or edited.
Copied Downloads HTML files are prototype/reference tools, not canonical tools.
H5.88A2 adds a preserved scene-composition prototype reference only; it does not promote any prototype to canonical implementation or runtime wiring.

scene composition / sticker placement / layout JSON export

repoLocalPrototypeFindings.purpose: Preview frame-based animation evidence from embedded manifests and hardcoded source/derived image paths.
repoLocalPrototypeFindings.currentMaturity: medium: useful and repo-local for evidence review, but not generalized or registry-fed.
strengths: Action/animation buttons are generated from embedded manifest animations.
FPS slider and play/pause controls are useful enough to preserve.
One-shot versus loop behavior exists in several prototypes.
Frame stepping/playback code is a strong seed for future flipbook viewer behavior.
weaknesses: Hardcoded embedded manifests and image paths.
No asset registry or pantry discovery.
Evidence-specific output rather than reusable app shell.
Review/runtime boundary metadata exists in embedded data but is not elevated into a clear UX contract.
repoLocalPrototypeFindings.recommendation: Preserve behavior patterns, rebuild as a registry-fed GlyphForge flipbook viewer.

reusableFeatureCandidates: Flipbook: canvas frame playback, FPS slider, play/pause, animation/action buttons, loop/one-shot handling, frame-rect driven canvas sizing.
Sprite Box Annotator: drag/resize bbox editing, snap grid, zoom/fit, labels, status select, notes, coordinate fields, JSON copy/import.

Particle FX Viewer: recipe-like effect definitions, effect selector, click/touch target casting, active particle/effect counters, generic emitter pattern, specialized lightning/rainbow effect classes.
All tools: single-file offline prototype portability is useful for fast evidence review and should inform dev ergonomics.

reusableFeatureCandidates.feature: scene composition board with draggable stickers/entities, snap grid, delete/backspace removal, live JSON layout export, and copy-to-clipboard handoff
reusableFeatureCandidates.futureUse: Sticker/Picture Book scene composition/layout mode for planning background anchors, prop placement, and runtime draft layouts after later approval

rebuildCandidates.reason: A shared shell should own registry loading, asset selection, status/runtime boundary banners, navigation, and export actions.
Evidence flipbooks have the best playback behavior but need external manifest loading and clearer review/runtime boundary display.
Sprite Box Annotator is the strongest manual region editing seed and should become the first practical authoring/review surface after the shell.
Particle experiments should stay separate from sprite cleanup and eventually output explicit preset manifests.

rebuildCandidates.rebuildAs: GlyphForge Sticker/Picture Book scene composition mode
rebuildCandidates.reason: Useful Level 8 layout workflow exists but must be rebuilt around pantry/manifest registry input, background anchors, asset status display, import/export schemas, and runtime-boundary warnings.

retireOrArchiveCandidates: Hardcoded evidence HTML paths as canonical application architecture.
Depending on C:/Users/kryst/Downloads paths after H5.88A preservation.
Treating visual-only, marker, rune, glow, arrow, tech, particle, or hazard-looking labels as gameplay approval.
Prototype-local status strings without a shared manifest/runtime boundary contract.
Copying one-off HTML directly into production tool surfaces without a rebuild lane.
